rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Bane
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Bane in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Battleborn
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

rules.name: Bravery Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Evasive
rules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where most models have this rule.

rules.name: Melee Shrouding
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for charging, that enemy unit gets -2" range to a min. of 6".

rules.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Mend
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

rules.name: Rapid Rush
rules.description: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Rapid Rush Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rapid Rush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Re-Deployment
rules.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Shred
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Smash
rules.description: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Steadfast
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Versatile Expert
rules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) on their weapons, or get +1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Versatile Reach
rules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, all models with this rule in this unit either get +4" range when shooting or move +2" when charging.

rules.name: Versatile Reach Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Reach. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

spells.name: Advanced Sight
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable on their weapons when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Blessed Ammo
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Shred on its weapons when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Cerebral Trauma
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 24" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Smash.

spells.name: Lightning Fog
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each.

spells.name: Protective Dome
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Evasive once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Psychic Terror
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 3 hits with Bane.
